summary: The change passes. It does what was asked: docs/spec.toml now has sourced requirements for Project Olympus sections 7 to 10, the governing philosophy and each addendum from 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-24. That is 57 new requirements, plus three open questions that each quote both conflicting statements. I ran `cargo test -p xtask --test spec` (22 passed, including the_real_spec_passes and the new negative cases for a non-verbatim quote under section 7+, a missing section 8 requirement, and a heading dated 2026-10-25) and `cargo test -p xtask --test policy` (12 passed). I also checked the quotes by hand against BRIEF.md. The test now cuts the brief at the first heading dated after 2026-10-24 and requires coverage of every new part. Section 1-6 entries are unchanged; only two header comment lines changed. D144 and the changelog line record the decision with its alternatives. All four changed files are on the deliverables list. The findings are minor: a few quotes are cut short to avoid words the boundary scan rejects (\"Context and\" barely supports its statement), and the spec's header comment still describes the old coverage. fmt and clippy are clean per Athena's recorded checks.
